text:
Maya R: quick sync — accessibility nit for stacked metric cards. We have small inline legends now; need a plan for screen readers and focus order. Current proto: legends are SVG swatches + short labels. Thoughts?

Tara P: SVG swatches need aria-hidden if we also provide text label. Ideally each legend item is a button when it toggles series visibility. Otherwise, mark as presentation and provide a separate textual legend for screen readers.

Kevin L: For dense cards, we prefer no visible legends. Instead, put the metric name + unit in the card header and expose a "Chart details" button that opens an overlay with legend and series descriptions. Keeps default view clean.

Elliot S: microcopy for the overlay: title: "Chart details"; body: list of series with short descriptions, colors, and units. Include a CTA "Toggle series visibility" which keyboard users can operate.

Maya R: also need guidance on axis ticks: do we show 2 ticks (min/max) or 4 ticks with small labels? fewer ticks look cleaner but can hide trends. propose default 2 ticks and allow expanded view with 4 in full chart mode.

Tara P: note: unit abbreviations must be consistent. Use "ms", "%", and "req/s" across the board. Avoid long unit names in small spaces.

DesignBot: a11y check: ensure that the "Chart details" button has aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing to the overlay panel. Also ensure modal overlay traps focus and returns focus on close.

Maya R: action items assigned. Will update the figma with the overlay and sample screen-reader-only legend markup. Thanks team.
